title: Android 10 notification trend arrow points in wrong direction
body:
The downwards trend arrow icon in the persistent notification is pointing in the wrong direction on Android 10. I'm using a Google Pixel XL.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/bPSJRJ6TntrdqGBm7

comments.body:
Think this is a duplicate of my issue here:

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1016

Might get a chance to delve into some of the xdrip code and have a look with all this down time although Android isn't something I develop on frequently.
